concepts.definition: Publisher's classification of the kind of description text attached to the IP right application (application_description.description_type). In this snapshot every observed value is 'description'; the list is not asserted to be exhaustive of the publisher's vocabulary. It classifies the description record, not the application's status or the business.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept classifies a description record attached to an IP application; ext.licence.category and ext.licence.authorisation are owned by licence and describe an authorisation, so reuse would change owner and meaning.

concepts.definition: Free-text description of the IP right application as published (application_description.description_value), e.g. a title or abstract-like statement of the subject matter. It describes the application, not the party or the business, and is not asserted to be a complete specification, a claim scope or evidence of grant or enforceability.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept carries descriptive text of an IP application; entity.legal_name, entity.trading_name and ext.licence.authorisation have different owners and meanings, so reuse would change meaning.
